subject: Discovery recap + proposed next steps - Brightware
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightware.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@brightware.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed next steps - Brightware

Hi Alex / Samantha,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on Brightware's priority to reduce per-query latency for customer-facing search while keeping costs predictable. Quick recap of what I heard: 

- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for search reranking from ~250ms to sub-150ms at p95 for 1k qps
- Traffic profile: spiky daytime load across US region; multi-tenant architecture with strict data separation
- Success metrics: latency p95, per-1M-token cost, and ability to autoscale for bursts without SLA violations
- Constraints: SOC 2 required, customer data cannot be logged to shared buckets, procurement timeline ~Q3

Next steps I suggest:
1) Tech deep-dive with our Solutions Engineer to validate integration and SLA targets (30-45m)
2) Pilot: 4-week Dedicated pool with prefix caching and tailored batching to measure cost/latency in your environment
3) Commercial: outline of pricing + reserved capacity/commit options if pilot meets objectives

I attached a 1-pager recap and a sample pilot SOW for your review. Do any of these next steps make sense from your side? If so, when is a good time for the SE call next week? I can loop in our Solutions Engineer and a technical account lead.

Thanks — happy to adjust based on what makes sense for you.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Neha — quick help? Alex hasn't replied to the recap or my follow-up. Brightware looks like a strong fit but procurement is a common blocker. Do you have bandwidth to: 

- Offer a short 2-week proof-of-concept option (lightweight, no-cost pilot) as a nudge?
- Or recommend a discount/credits structure we can propose to get them into a pilot before Q3 procurement windows close?

Proposed short outreach script if we decide to pivot to trial/credits: 
"Alex — quick note to check whether a lightweight, no-cost 2-week POC to validate latency and integration would help unblock procurement. We can ship a Dedicated pilot and a short technical onboarding — no long-term commitment. Happy to jump on a 20 minute call to align scope."

If you can OK a pilot offer, I can send a more direct follow-up to push for a calendar time. Thoughts?

Thanks — Marissa
